hero.title: Master the Road, Drive the Future
hero.description: The first premium driving academy in Alam Sutera using 100% Electric Vehicles. Experience smooth, silent, and sustainable learning.

home.courseMaterialDesc: Course material that you learn will make you more confident in driving.

material.materialTheoryDesc2: Cockpit training (ergonomic seating position, center and side mirror adjustment, and seat belt use)
material.materialTheoryDesc3: Introduction to instruments (gas pedal, brake, transmission lever, handbrake, indicator lights in the dashboard)
material.materialTheoryDesc4: Safety check (check the condition of tires, oil and radiator water before driving)
material.initialControlDesc: Starting & stopping the engine (standard procedure for starting the engine safely)
material.initialControlDesc2: Accelerator pedal technique safely (balanced and smooth)
material.initialControlDesc3: Braking and Tree and tree techniques (smooth braking and how to stop at a certain point precisely)
material.basicManeuveringDesc: Steering control (steering wheel turning technique when turning quickly)
material.basicManeuveringDesc2: Reverse (controlling the car to reverse using only the rearview mirror)
material.basicManeuveringDesc3: Turning at an intersection (technique for taking the correct turning angle to the left or right)
material.uphillDownhill: Driving Techniques on Uphill & Downhill Roads
material.parkingDesc: Reverse parking at an angle or straight (enter the parking slot with the car in reverse)
material.parkingDesc2: Parallel parking (a technique of inserting a car between two other vehicles parallel to each other)
material.highwayDesc: Road signs and markings (obey traffic signs, no parking signs and road markings)
material.highwayDesc2: Driving ethics (using turn signals, maintaining a safe distance, and how to overtake other vehicles correctly)
material.highwayDesc3: Blind spot (a technique for checking areas that are not visible in the rearview mirror before changing lanes)

tosContent.welcome: Welcome to Drive Master Indonesia. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the website {url} and our driving school services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
tosContent.servicesDesc: Drive Master Indonesia provides professional driving instruction services, including theoretical training and practical on-road sessions. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the services at any time without prior notice.
tosContent.accountsDesc: To access certain features of our platform, such as booking sessions, you must register for an account. You agree to:
tosContent.accountsList1: Provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process.
tosContent.accountsList2: Maintain the security of your password and accept all risks of unauthorized access to your account.
tosContent.accountsList3: Notify us immediately if you discover or suspect any security breaches related to our services.
tosContent.feesDesc: All prices for our driving packages are listed in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Payment obligations include:
tosContent.feesList1: Payment Processing: Payments are processed securely via third-party gateways (e.g., Midtrans). We do not store your full financial credentials.
tosContent.feesList2: Refund Policy: Requests for refunds are subject to our internal review and are typically only granted if requested at least 48 hours before the start of the first session.
tosContent.schedulingDesc: Efficient scheduling is key to our service quality. Our policy includes:
tosContent.schedulingList1: Booking: Sessions must be booked at least 24 hours in advance through the student dashboard.
tosContent.schedulingList2: Rescheduling: You may reschedule a session through our platform at no extra cost if done at least 24 hours before the scheduled time.
tosContent.schedulingList3: No-Show: Failure to attend a scheduled session without prior notice will result in the session being marked as completed and non-refundable.
tosContent.obligationsDesc: As a student of Drive Master Indonesia, you agree to:
tosContent.obligationsList1: Possess a valid temporary or permanent driver's permit as required by local law.
tosContent.obligationsList2: Follow the instructions of the assigned instructor at all times during practical sessions.
tosContent.obligationsList3: Maintain a zero-tolerance policy regarding alcohol or drug use before or during training sessions.
tosContent.liabilityDesc: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Drive Master Indonesia shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from your use of our services or any interaction with our instructors. While we strive for absolute safety, practical driving involves inherent risks.
tosContent.changesDesc: We reserve the right to change or modify these Terms at any time. If we make changes, we will notify you by revising the date at the top of the policy or by posting a notice on our homepage. Your continued use of the services confirms your acceptance of the revised Terms.
tosContent.contactDesc: If you have any questions or concerns regarding these Terms, please reach out to us:

privacyContent.welcome: Welcome to Drive Master Indonesia. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our website and in using our services. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website {url} and use our driving school services.
privacyContent.collectDesc: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you register for our services, make a purchase, or interact with our website. This includes:
privacyContent.collectList1: Personal Identification Information: Name, email address, phone number, physical address, date of birth, and driver's license details.
privacyContent.collectList2: Payment Information: Details required for processing payments, such as credit/debit card numbers (processed securely by third-party payment gateways like Midtrans).
privacyContent.collectList3: Usage Data: Information about how you access and use our website, including IP address, browser type, pages viewed, and time spent on pages.
privacyContent.useDesc: The information we collect is used for various purposes, including:
privacyContent.useList1: To provide and maintain our services, including scheduling driving lessons and managing your account.
privacyContent.useList2: To process transactions and send you related information, including purchase confirmations and invoices.
privacyContent.useList3: To improve our website and services based on your feedback and usage patterns.
privacyContent.useList4: To send you marketing and promotional communications (if you have opted in).
privacyContent.useList5: To comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes.
privacyContent.disclosureDesc: We may share your information with third parties in the following situations:
privacyContent.disclosureList1: Service Providers: With third-party vendors, consultants, and other service providers who perform services for us or on our behalf (e.g., payment processing, email delivery, hosting services).
privacyContent.disclosureList2: Legal Requirements: If required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court order or government agency).
privacyContent.disclosureList3: Business Transfers: In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business to another company.
privacyContent.securityDesc: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, alteration, and disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyContent.rightsDesc: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacyContent.rightsList1: The right to access, update, or delete the information we have on you.
privacyContent.rightsList2: The right to object to our processing of your personal data.
privacyContent.rightsList3: The right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal information.
privacyContent.rightsList5: The right to withdraw consent at any time.
privacyContent.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at {email}.
privacyContent.changesDesc: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
privacyContent.contactDesc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
